title: INFRA — /health: add Tailscale VPN vault reachability check (Mac Mini ping)
rationale: Tailscale running locally ≠ vault reachable. Add VAULT_TAILSCALE_IP ping to /health (alongside existing Hetzner ping pattern). Shows vault online/offline so operator catches VPN issues before inference silently fails.

tasks.description: Add VAULT_TAILSCALE_IP ping check to cmdHealth() in scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-system.ts. Pattern: same as HETZNER_TAILSCALE_IP check. Append vaultSection to tailscaleSection output. Show ✅/❌/⚠️ vault reachability.
